findings.title: Final answer is copied as shared experience instead of generating a reusable lesson
findings.requirement: Automatically summarize reusable experience after completed work without sharing private facts or credentials.
findings.evidence: The initial record stored CompletionReport.summary verbatim; the Python completion report used final_response as summary; future member materials labeled the text Shared lesson.
findings.consequence: The feature archives deliverable output rather than learning, and may carry task-private content into shared materials.
findings.minimum_change: Generate a separate concise reusable-experience field in the existing completion turn and persist only that field, with explicit exclusions for private facts, raw user content, credentials, paths and file contents.

findings.title: REPAIR_REQUIRED summaries are shared as lessons without their verdict
findings.requirement: Only successful completed results enter shared experience, or non-pass results must remain clearly identified as correction-needed.
findings.evidence: Initial insertion checked only report != null and stored no verdict; TaskExecutionService permits REPAIR_REQUIRED reports for non-planning tasks.
findings.consequence: Future workers can mistake a result explicitly requiring repair for a successful lesson.
findings.minimum_change: Persist experience only for PASS, or retain and visibly propagate verdict when intentionally preserving repair experience.
